cards.audioText: What are the differences between these traditional aircraft instruments and modern advanced flight instrument cockpits?
cards.audioTextZh: 这些传统飞机仪表与现代先进飞行仪表驾驶舱有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: The main benefit is improved situational awareness. Compared with the older method, it gives pilots clearer information, better monitoring, and more time to make safe decisions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要好处是提升态势感知。与较旧的方式相比，它能给飞行员更清晰的信息、更好的监控能力，并为安全决策争取更多时间。

cards.audioText: What challenges do pilots face when operating aircraft with these traditional instruments?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员操作这些传统仪表飞机时会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are higher scan workload, less integrated information, and greater dependence on manual cross-checking. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括扫视负荷更高、信息整合程度更低并且更依赖人工交叉检查。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。
